text.p: Zoran Corp and CompCore Multimedia Inc said on Monday that they completed Zoran's acquisition of CompCore.

Stockholders of both companies voted to approve the merger of CompCore with a wholly-owned subsidiary of Zoran at special meetings of stockholders held on December 27, 1996, the companies said in a joint statement.
Zoran develops and markets integrated circuits and software for digital video and audio applications.
CompCore provides video and audio hardware designs to original equipment manufacturers, the company said.

In October, the companies annouced that Zoran agreed to acquire CompCore in a deal valued about $57 million. CompCore stock holders would receive 0.6408 of a Zoran share for each CompCore share held, the companies had said.
It could not immediately be determined if the terms of the deal have changed since October and how many shares will be issued under the agreement.

A spokeswoman for Zoran said CompCore shareholders would hold about 25 percent of Zoran's stock. On a fully diluted basis that includes options, Zoran is issuing about 2.85 million shares to CompCore holders, the spokeswoman said.
